Figure caption: a) Illustrations of liposomes, cubosomes, hexosomes, and micellar cubosomes. The multi‐component lipid systems self‐assemble into various mesophases with complex nanostructures.[ 40 ] b) SAXS plots of intensity vs. q for liposomes, cubosomes, hexosomes, and micellar cubosomes in water, with corresponding Bragg peaks of the highly ordered primitive inverse bicontinuous cubic phase (Q2 P), the inverse hexagonal phase (H2), and the inverse discontinuous micellar cubic phase (I2). c) Cryo‐TEM micrographs liposomes, cubosomes, hexosomes, and micellar cubosomes, with the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) of the highlighted areas. The insets contain the FFT of the ordered non‐lamellar LLCNPs, showing the characteristic motifs of Im3m (cubic), H2 (hexagonal), and Fd3m (micellar cubic) crystallographic space groups. Scale bars = 200 nm. d) Size distribution of the LLCNPs, all with an average hydrodynamic diameter of 210 ± 10 nm. n = 3. e) Polydispersity index (PDI) of LLCNPs, indicating high size homogeneity within formulations. n = 3. f) Zeta potential of LLCNPs. n = 3.

Figure caption: a) Workflow for elucidating LLCNP internalization pathways. Cells are pre‐treated with various endocytic inhibitors for 1 h, and then separately co‐incubated with liposomes, cubosomes, hexosomes, and micellar cubosomes for 1 and 6 h. LLCNP cell uptake in the presence of inhibitors is analyzed using flow cytometry. Passive internalization pathways remain uninhibited. LLCNP uptake in the presence of inhibitors after b) 1 h, and c) 6 h. The normalized cellular uptake % represents the reliance of liposomes, cubosomes, hexosomes, and micellar cubosomes on specific endocytic pathways. N = 3. ns p > 0.05, * p ≤ 0.05, ** p ≤ 0.01, *** p ≤ 0.001 compared to uninhibited nanoparticle‐treated control cells (Student's T‐test). Data = mean ± SD. ^Duplicates (n = 2) were obtained in cases where insufficient cells were counted within an experimental triplicate for flow cytometry. d) Energy‐dependent uptake of LLCNPs. The unnormalized mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) of LLCNPs was plotted to illustrate the difference in intensity levels, and the proportion of passive cell uptake to uninhibited cell uptake detected after 1 and 6 h of incubation with the LLCNPs. e) Schematic representations of reported non‐endocytic internalization pathways, adapted from various sources.[ 45 , 46 ]

Figure caption: MCR‐ALS images generated from Raman microscopy comparing uptake of lipid nanoparticles after 6 h incubation. a) False color images of MCR‐ALS components representing the cell (green) and lipid‐rich regions (red). b) The lipid uptake was quantified by integrating the intensities from the lipid‐rich regions and dividing by total cell area (see Experimental Section for details), showing the increase in lipid content for the non‐lamellar lipid nanoparticles relative to liposomes.

Figure caption: a) Schematic representation of workflow for determining LLCNP and endocytic marker colocalization. CHO cells were co‐incubated with FITC (or Alexa‐488) labeled endocytic markers and R18‐labeled LLCNPs for 1 and 6 h, and visualized using confocal microscopy to analyze the degree of colocalization using the Manders’ Colocalization Coefficient (MCC). b) MCC values of liposomes, cubosomes, hexosomes, and micellar cubosomes, separately co‐incubated with endocytic markers Dex (macropinocytosis), Trf (CME), and CTB (CAV‐ME). The MCC values were calculated by analyzing at least 5 random fields (n ≥ 5). Data = mean ± SD. c) The MCC values representing the relative degree of the LLCNPs and endocytic markers that occupy the same endosomal compartment. MCC values from 1 and 6 h are represented in the graph.

Figure caption: Confocal micrographs of rhodamine‐labeled a) liposomes, b) cubosomes, c) hexosomes, and d) micellar cubosomes after 1 and 6 h of treatment. The TRITC channel (red) visualizes the dynamics of LLCNP‐cell interactions, the TD channel (transmitted light) illustrates the cells. Scale bars = 10 µm. e) Percentage breakdown of the observed heterogeneous behavior amongst the different LLCNPs. Cells were visually assessed manually and tabulated. At least 100 cells per nanoparticle treatment at the two time points were assessed (n ≥ 100). The percentage is not representative of the fluorescence intensity, but the frequency of observed dynamics. ** p ≤ 0.01, **** p ≤ 0.0001 (Fisher's exact test).
